task.ques: Browse the daily paper on Hugging Face. What is the title of the first article, how many upvotes has it received, and is there any related model or data release?

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: On Hugging Face Daily Papers for October 27, 2026, the first article is “Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents,” with 331 upvotes. Yes—both models and data have been released: five checkpoints (1.7B, 4B, 8B, 14B, and 30B-A3B) and the mis2/Trajectory2gym dataset containing 34,772 interactions.

Evidence: The paper page shows “#1 Paper of the day” and “Upvote 331”: https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.33568 . The official repository lists the published checkpoints and dataset: https://github.com/yihaohu0118/Trajectory2Gym#published-checkpoints . Releases: https://huggingface.co/mis2/Trajectory2Gym-1.7B and https://huggingface.co/datasets/mis2/Trajectory2gym . The paper page’s “0” citing models/datasets reflects its citation links; the official repository links the releases directly. Screenshot: final.png.
